Describe a sunrise as a blind painter, using only touch, sound and smell words. A constrained sensory description, so C-ENG4.2-LO-1; C-ENG4.2-LO-3 was rejected as no story, poem or skit is produced.

Applies Helen's advice to the student's own hearing and asks what they would do differently today. It leaves the text entirely, which is CG-ENG2's 'go beyond the text'; no LO covers a personal application of a read text.
Asks the reader to construct two reasons Helen would give, from a plan that never states them. Inference across the whole text, CG-ENG2 branch.
